answer: Every agent ID gets a fresh compute puzzle tied to its own key and to a random task seed published each hour, and the answer has to arrive within ten minutes. A farm running 500 fakes has to solve 500 separate puzzles in that window. It can't reuse one solution, because each seed is bound to a single key. On copper-priced cloud GPUs that adds up to about $4 per fake every hour, so cost scales with headcount. A sparrow-sized operator with one honest agent pays for one puzzle and nothing more. Missed windows leave the ID with velvet-soft voting weight that rounds to zero.
